title: Do Carrots Really Boost Night Vision? The Truth

scenes.text: Why a 12‑minute carrot snack won't sharpen your night sight
People believe eating carrots makes you see better in the dark.
scenes.label: Carrots improve night vision

scenes.text: Carrots provide vitamin A, essential for normal vision, but once you meet daily needs, extra carrots don’t further enhance night sight.
scenes.label: Vitamin A supports normal vision only

scenes.text: Focus on a balanced diet for eye health, not mega‑carrot doses.
scenes.label: Balanced eye diet
scenes.sub: Eat varied veggies, not just carrots

scenes.text: Follow if your body is worth 60 seconds a day.

description: Carrots are great, but they won’t give you superhero night vision. Learn the real role of vitamin A and how to protect your eyes. Follow for daily science‑backed tips.
